Huron is a global consultancy that collaborates with clients to drive strategic growth, ignite innovation and navigate constant change. Through a combination of strategy, expertise and creativity, we help clients accelerate operational, digital and cultural transformation, enabling the change they need to own their future.

Join our team as the expert you are now and create your future.
We are seeking an experienced AI/ML Engineer with expertise in both machine learning (ML) and Generative AI (GenAI) to join our Emerging Technology Practice. In this role, you will drive the development of cutting-edge AI models and solutions-from statistical modeling and predictive analytics to advanced generative and agentic applications.
Design and develop AI-powered systems using both traditional ML and Generative AI techniques, including prompt engineering, fine-tuning, embeddings, and Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) architectures
Build intelligent applications and agentic systems that can perform tasks autonomously or interactively, using frameworks such as LangChain, LangGraph, AutoGen, CrewAI, or similar
Architect and implement end-to-end RAG pipelines, including document ingestion, chunking strategies, embedding generation, vector indexing, hybrid search, and contextual response generation
Develop modular, well-documented APIs and service components (e.g., using FastAPI or Flask) to enable model integration and consumption
Design, build, and manage end-to-end AI pipelines, including data ingestion, transformation, validation, model training, inference, deployment, and knowledge retrieval workflows
Leverage AWS and Azure AI/ML services (e.g., Bedrock, SageMaker, Azure OpenAI, Azure ML, Document Intelligence, vector databases, etc.) to accelerate development and deployment
Implement observability, evaluation, and monitoring mechanisms to track model accuracy, drift, retrieval quality, grounding fidelity, reliability, and task-level reasoning
Optimize RAG systems for latency, scalability, cost efficiency, and response quality in production environments
Collaborate with software engineers, data scientists, solution architects, and business stakeholders to ensure seamless solution design and transition to production
Support both rapid experimentation (POCs, pilots) and robust, scalable deployments, depending on the maturity of each use case
Stay up to date with emerging trends in Generative AI, AI agents, orchestration frameworks, RAG evaluation techniques, and continuous improvement methodologies
4 to 6 years of hands-on experience in AI/ML development or intelligent application engineering
Strong proficiency in Python and familiarity with modern ML/AI libraries (e.g., scikit-learn, PyTorch, TensorFlow, OpenAI APIs)
Hands-on experience designing and deploying RAG-based systems, including embeddings, vector databases (e.g., FAISS, Pinecone, Chroma, Azure AI Search), and retrieval optimization techniques
Experience building APIs or backend services using FastAPI, Flask, or equivalent frameworks
Exposure to agent frameworks (e.g., LangGraph, AutoGen) and multi-agent orchestration patterns
Experience with orchestration standards or tools such as MCP or agent routing protocols is a plus
Familiarity with cloud platforms (AWS, Azure) and containerization tools (Docker)
Hands-on experience with cloud-based ML platforms such as Azure Machine Learning, AWS SageMaker, or Google AI/ML services
Experience with MLOps pipelines, CI/CD for model delivery, RAG evaluation frameworks (e.g., RAGAS), or model monitoring is a plus
Knowledge of AI system evaluation, observability, prompt performance testing, and grounding validation is a plus
Ability to work on cross-functional teams, balance multiple projects, and communicate effectively with technical and non-technical audiences
Cloud certifications in AI/ML services (Azure, AWS, or Google Cloud) are a plus
Bachelor s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Data Science, or a related field
Position Level Associate
Country India

Artificial Intelligence Engineer - Anthropic

AI Engineers with 3 5 years of relevant experience in Generative AI
You ll need to be a hands-on problem-solver at the intersection of software engineering and AI. This role requires deep technical curiosity, experience with modern LLM stacks, and a strong grasp of foundational AI concepts, as well as advanced prompt engineering practices.
What you ll do:
Build Advanced AI Agents: Move beyond simple chains to develop complex, multi-step AI agents that can reason, plan, and execute tasks. You ll become an expert in advanced architectural patterns, orchestrating both deterministic and non-deterministic workflows, and exploring techniques like reinforcement learning to refine agent policies.
Implement Deep Tool & API Integration: Equip agents with the ability to perform real-world actions by implementing Tool Calling and MCPs, and integrating them with a diverse set of internal and external tools, databases, and APIs.
Master Systematic Prompt Engineering: Design sophisticated prompt chains using techniques like Chain-of-Thought and ReAct, and build systems to test, version, and manage these prompts like code.
Drive Rigorous Evaluation & Experimentation: Develop automated evaluation suites to benchmark agent performance on metrics like correctness, relevance, and safety, driving continuous improvement through data-driven A/B testing.
Implement Safety & Guardrails: Build critical safety layers and validation steps to ensure agents operate reliably and prevent them from taking unintended, incorrect, or harmful actions.
Own AI System Observability & Optimization: Implement comprehensive logging, metrics, and tracing to monitor AI systems in production. Manage the trade-offs between performance, latency, and cost by implementing techniques like multi-LLM routing and advanced caching.
Lead Enterprise-Scale System Ownership: Take true ownership of production AI components, ensuring their security, reliability, and scalability as part of our robust microservices architecture.
What you should have:
Core AI & Software Fundamentals
Solid Python Proficiency: Expertise in Python and its ecosystem, including libraries like NumPy and Pandas.
Machine Learning & Deep Learning Concepts: Have a solid grasp of the machine learning landscape, including common model types and when to apply them. You should be proficient in at least one major ML framework like PyTorch or TensorFlow .
Data Processing & Refinement: Have practical experience with the day-to-day work of cleaning, preprocessing, and transforming structured and unstructured data to make it suitable for AI models.
Broad AI Application Knowledge: Understand the principles behind a range of modern AI applications, such as semantic search, text summarization, chatbots, data extraction from unstructured text, and computer vision tasks like image analysis and object detection.
API Development Experience: Have hands-on experience building, testing, and deploying RESTful APIs .
Core Generative AI Proficiency
Prompt Engineering: Context Engineering: Understand the critical practice of strategically managing the information provided in an LLM s context window. You understand and have practised the fundamentals of crafting effective prompts to guide and steer LLM behaviour. This includes using patterns like Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), managing conversational history, and providing effective few-shot examples to ground the model and improve response quality.
Understanding of LLMs and the Ecosystem: Have a strong grasp of how Large Language Models work, their capabilities, and their limitations. You are familiar with the Hugging Face ecosystem.
Hands-on Experience with LLM Frameworks: Have built projects using modern LLM application frameworks (e.g., LangChain , LlamaIndex ).
Knowledge of Fine-Tuning: Understand the concepts and use cases for adapting models to specific domains through fine-tuning.
Production Deployment of GenAI (nice to have): Have some experience deploying Generative AI solutions to a production environment and understand the unique considerations involved, such as managing latency, optimizing costs, ensuring security, and monitoring for performance degradation or model drift.
What would be great to have:
Strong Problem-Solving Mindset: You are naturally curious and adept at breaking down complex, ambiguous problems into manageable steps.
Clear Communication: You can articulate technical concepts and decisions clearly to your peers.
What we offer:
Competitive salary with performance-linked bonus
A competitive salary and performance bonus.
Comprehensive health insurance.
Flexible working hours and a hybrid work model.
A budget for professional development, conferences, and certifications.
The opportunity to work on diverse AI projects in a company with a 15+ year history of excellence.

Job Description

We are seeking a skilled Generative AI Engineer to join our team at Mumbai, where you will harness model capabilities to implement cutting-edge algorithms and solutions across myriad industries.

You will serve as a pivotal link between Data Scientists, ML and Platform Engineers to unleash the potential of Generative AI technology by implementing business-centric solutions. You will help customers find the appropriate level of refinement among semantic search, RAG, agents, and ultimately fine-tuning to reach their value delivery threshold in the most cost-effective way.

Beyond crafting prompts, you will be responsible for designing and building robust and scalable products starting with benchmarks of candidate FMs through targeted requests, rapidly iterating prototypes, and validating product ideas. Your expertise in orchestrating the entire AI workflow will ensure the seamless integration of advanced models capabilities into applications, optimizing performance, security, compliance, scalability, and efficiency. You will competently navigate between prompts, chains, and agents while mastering the underlying infrastructure challenges.

We invest in your success through comprehensive training, combining internal programs with resources from our technology partners.

Join us if you are passionate about pushing the boundaries of AI technology and making a significant impact in enabling our customers to create GenAI-powered applications with confidence and a fast time to market.

Key Responsibilities

You are part of a cross-functional consulting team that drives the adoption of Generative AI in every imaginable sector, working step-by-step with customers to understand business requirements to design then build bespoke GenAI solutions.

Build applications powered by LLMs (OpenAI, Claude, Mistral, etc.) using LangChain, LlamaIndex, and related GenAI frameworks.
Implement RAG pipelines with vector DBs (Pinecone, FAISS, pgvector, ChromaDB) for grounding LLM responses with internal knowledge
Develop multimodal AI solutions (text, audio, image) and build autonomous agents where relevant.
Drive MLOps excellence: CI/CD (ML pipelines), drift detection, canary releases, retraining schedules.
Design robust and reusable prompt templates using CoT, ReAct, Graph-of-Thought, and Agent flows.
Continuously improve model reliability, relevance, and UX by tuning prompt flows
Deploy GenAI models on AWS/GCP/Azure using services like SageMaker, Bedrock, Vertex AI
Ensure performance observability, security guardrails, and compliance (GDPR, Responsible AI)
Work with DevOps teams to integrate GenAI solutions into microservices and APIs (FastAPI/Flask)
Benchmark open-source and commercial LLMs for use-case fit and cost-performance tradeoffs
Evaluate fine-tuning strategies (PEFT, LoRA, RLHF) where applicable for proprietary use cases
Support solution architects and cross-functional teams in delivering PoCs and enterprise-grade rollouts
Document frameworks, best practices, risks, and learnings for future scaling Qualifications
Bachelor s/masters degree in computer science, AI, or a related field.
5+ years of experience in NLP/ML/AI with at least 3 year hands-on in GenAI.
Strong coding skills in Python with frameworks like PyTorch, Hugging Face, LangChain, and LlamaIndex.
Proven experience with cloud-based AI services (AWS/GCP/Azure) and APIs (OpenAI, Anthropic, Hugging Face).
Experience with vector databases: Qdrant, pgvector, Pinecone, FAISS, Milvus, or Weaviate.
Familiarity with prompt engineering, transformer architectures, and embedding techniques.
Excellent communication skills, with the ability to convey complex technical concepts to both highly technical and also non-technical stakeholders.
Sharp problem-solving skills.
Ability to collaborate with diverse teams.
